subject: Re: Startup program + committed-use proposal — post-call recap & asks
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@latticeai.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@latticeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap — startup program + committed-use options

Hi Priya / Daniel,

Thanks again for taking time today — helpful to walk through LatticeAI's ingestion profile and how inference fits into the product roadmap. Quick recap and concrete asks so we can get a tight quote out to legal/finance: 

Summary of what you shared (please correct if I missed anything):
- Initial production ramp: ~25–40M inference tokens/month for months 1–3 (chat + summarization).
- Expected ramp to ~120–160M tokens/month by month 9–12 given new vector search/agents features.
- Target budget range: $70k–$120k/month in the first 6 months, with appetite to commit to a predictable cadence if unit economics justify it.

Pricing levers we discussed:
- Startup program credits (one-off onboarding credit + % discount on initial run)
- Committed-use discounts (tiered by 6/12/24 month terms)
- Multi-year incentives / growth rebates for sustained ramp beyond commit

High-level provisional structure I want to lock with you so we can get legal a clean term sheet:
- Public hosted base rate (example): $1,500 per 1M tokens (pre-discount).
- Startup Accelerator: up to 40% credit on first $250k of spend applied over first 3 months (one-time).
- Committed-use tiers (applied to hosted rate): 6 mo = 12% off, 12 mo = 22% off, 24 mo = 28% off.
- Growth rebate: additional up to 8% rebate in year 2 if average monthly tokens > 2x year 1 baseline.

Example math for transparency: if you commit 12 months at a 22% discount and use the startup credit against the first $250k, your blended $/1M tokens in early months would be ~ $1,170 — falling toward ~$1,170–1,200 as volumes normalize depending on usage mix.

Asks / next steps from you:
1) Confirm whether you prefer a 6/12/24 month committed path (we can show concrete tiered pricing).
2) Confirm the initial monthly token expectation to build a sample quote (25M, 40M, or a range).
3) Any security or procurement constraints (SAML SSO, SOC2 attestation timeline, standard PoP language) to put in the term sheet.

I'll attach a quick pricing worksheet and a 1-page term summary for internal review. If you give a thumbs up on the 12-month path, we can lock the quote for 14 days and include an additional startup sweetener pending legal sign-off.

Attachments: redwood_pricing_quicklook_v1.xlsx (pricing worksheet), redwood_terms_summary_v1.pdf (term highlights)

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199
From: Priya Shah <priya@latticeai.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@latticeai.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Sep 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — startup program + committed-use options

Jonas —

Appreciate the clear recap and the example math. A few clarifications from our side:
- Confirming initial ramp: expecting ~30M tokens/month for months 1–2, ~45M for months 3–6, then higher as we launch agents in Q1. Those are still estimates but should be close.
- Budget: the $70k–$120k/month range is accurate for the first 6 months (higher end if we accelerate agent rollout).
- Startup support: the Accelerator credit sounds good — would need the credit to cover at least the first 2–3 months of variable costs while we close Series A bridge.

Requests:
1) Can you push a sample pricing table that shows the blended $/1M tokens at 30M, 45M, and 120M monthly usage under 6/12/24 month commits? (helps our CFO).
2) Any chance you can propose a shallow ramp guarantee rather than front-loaded commit? For example, a 12-month commit that starts at 30M/mo and grows to 120M/mo over 9 months (we’d like the discount to apply to the committed amount but not penalize under-runs in months 1–3).
3) Procurement asks: we need SOC2 type II report copy and standard DPAs; also SSO (SAML) is a must.

If you can include the sample tables, I’ll loop in our finance and legal and we can try to move this quickly.

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Shah | Head of Platform, LatticeAI
priya@latticeai.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya@latticeai.com>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@latticeai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap — startup program + committed-use options

Priya — thanks. Attached is a quicklook workbook with blended $/1M calculations at the usage points you called out (30M, 45M, 120M) across the three commit lengths. I also included two commitment flavors to address your ramp concern:

Option A — Straight commit (standard): discount applies to committed amount each month; under-runs billed at committed rate unless reconciled at renewal.
Option B — Phased ramp commit (recommended for startups): commit is billed at a baseline (e.g., 30M/mo) with a growth tranche that converts to discount-level pricing as you hit thresholds. This prevents heavy penalties early while still giving predictable unit economics.

Concrete numbers (sample):
- Pre-discount base: $1,500 / 1M tokens.
- Accelerator credit: 40% credit on first $250k of spend (applied across months 1–3).
- Committed discounts: 6mo = 12%, 12mo = 22%, 24mo = 28%.
- Phased ramp example (12mo): month 1–3 billed at baseline 30M/mo at 12mo discount level pricing applied to baseline, growth tranches priced at step discounts as thresholds are hit.

Blended examples from workbook (rounded):
- 30M/mo on 12mo phased ramp => ~$1,190 per 1M tokens effective in months 1–3 (post-credit), trending to ~$1,170 as credits expire and volume grows.
- 45M/mo on 12mo => ~$1,140 per 1M tokens blended.
- 120M/mo on 24mo => ~$1,080 per 1M tokens blended (including 24mo discount + growth rebate potential).

Procurement: Ben has uploaded our SOC2 type II and DPA templates to the shared drive; I linked them below and attached the 1-pager term summary. SAML is supported — we’ll include an onboarding checklist in the SOW.

Next steps I propose:
- Confirm preferred commit flavor (A or B) and term length.
- If you opt for 12mo and agree in principle, we can lock pricing for 14 days; I’ll request an approval from Ben to add an additional 5% one-time startup sweetener if signed within that window.
- I’ll send a draft term sheet + DocuSign link once you pick a path so your legal can review.

Links / attachments: pricing workbook attached. SOC2 & DPA: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/soc2-latticeai

Thanks —
Jonas
(Attachments: redwood_pricing_quicklook_v1.xlsx, redwood_terms_summary_v1.pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Startup program + committed-use proposal — approval and limited-time sweetener

Priya / Daniel —

Following Jonas’s note: happy to approve a limited-time extra startup concession to help LatticeAI through the bridge period. Confirming internal approval details here so your team has clarity: 

- Extra starter sweetener: additional 5% off the committed tier (stacked on top of the 22% 12mo discount) if LatticeAI signs a 12-month committed-use agreement within 14 days of the quote date. This is a one-time commercial concession (not precedent setting) and requires standard mutual NDA/terms.
- Finance ask: we’ll need a simple forecast by month for 12 months (you can use the workbook we attached) to finalize billing tranches.
- Legal: we can send a clean term sheet + DocuSign link once Priya confirms the 12mo phased ramp path.

HubSpot quote and preview DocuSign (preview link): https://app.hubspot.com/quote/7843/preview

Priya — if that works, reply here with “12mo phased — proceed” and we’ll fast-track the quote and lock the sweetener.

Best regards,
